The '''dining commons''' were located within the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. It was in these commons that [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] met with [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]]. At the same time, [[Kin Robb/Legends|Kin Robb]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] were having dinner together, not very far from them. [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] were also present, along with [[Zinn Paulness/Legends|Zinn Pauless]], [[Dantum Roohd/Legends|Dantum Roohd]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="Senate Spy" />
